fn rs_read_declaration(reader: *RmdReader, user: *u8) -> *RmdDecl {
    var stage: *RsStage = user as *RsStage;
    if rr_is_name(reader, "resource") {
        (*reader).token.kind = RR_RECORD;
        var declaration: *RmdDecl = rr_record(reader);
        if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdDecl); }
        if !rr_is_name(reader, "drop") {
            rr_error(reader, (*reader).token.offset, "expected drop FUNCTION after resource record");
            return null(*RmdDecl);
        }
        rr_next(reader);
        var drop_name: *RmdName = rr_name(reader);
        rr_expect(reader, 59u32, "expected ';' after resource drop function");
        if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdDecl); }
        var resource: *RsResource = rs_alloc(stage, sizeof(RsResource), alignof(RsResource)) as *RsResource;
        if resource == null(*RsResource) { (*reader).failed = true; return null(*RmdDecl); }
        (*resource).declaration = declaration;
        (*resource).drop_name = drop_name;
        (*resource).next = (*stage).resources;
        (*stage).resources = resource;
        return declaration;
    }
    if rr_is_name(reader, "unsafe") {
        rr_next(reader);
        if (*reader).token.kind != RR_FN {
            rr_error(reader, (*reader).token.offset, "expected fn after unsafe declaration modifier");
            return null(*RmdDecl);
        }
        var declaration: *RmdDecl = rr_function(reader);
        if !(*reader).failed {
            rs_put(stage, &(*stage).unsafe_functions, declaration as usize, declaration as *u8);
            if (*stage).failed { (*reader).failed = true; }
        }
        return declaration;
    }
    return null(*RmdDecl);
}

fn rs_read_statement(reader: *RmdReader, user: *u8) -> *RmdStmt {
    var kind: u32 = 0u32;
    if rr_is_name(reader, "defer") { kind = RS_DEFER; }
    else { if rr_is_name(reader, "unsafe") { kind = RS_UNSAFE; }
    else { if rr_is_name(reader, "forget") { kind = RS_FORGET; }
    else { return null(*RmdStmt); } } }
    var statement: *RmdStmt = rr_new_stmt(reader, kind, (*reader).token.offset);
    rr_next(reader);
    if (*reader).failed { return null(*RmdStmt); }
    if kind == RS_UNSAFE { (*statement).body = rr_block(reader); }
    else {
        (*statement).expr = rr_expression(reader);
        rr_expect(reader, 59u32, "expected ';' after resource statement");
    }
    return statement;
}

fn rs_read_prefix(reader: *RmdReader, user: *u8) -> *RmdExpr {
    var kind: u32 = 0u32;
    if rr_is_name(reader, "move") { kind = RS_MOVE; }
    else { if rr_is_name(reader, "read") { kind = RS_READ; }
    else { if rr_is_name(reader, "mut") { kind = RS_MUT; }
    else { return null(*RmdExpr); } } }
    var expression: *RmdExpr = rr_new_expr(reader, kind, (*reader).token.offset);
    rr_next(reader);
    if !(*reader).failed { (*expression).left = rr_prefix(reader); }
    return expression;
}

fn rs_read_type(reader: *RmdReader, user: *u8) -> *RmdTypeSyntax {
    var kind: u32 = 0u32;
    if rr_is_name(reader, "read") { kind = RS_READ; }
    else { if rr_is_name(reader, "mut") { kind = RS_MUT; }
    else { return null(*RmdTypeSyntax); } }
    var syntax: *RmdTypeSyntax = rr_new_type(reader, kind, (*reader).token.offset);
    rr_next(reader);
    if !(*reader).failed { (*syntax).base = rr_type(reader); }
    return syntax;
}

// Read one complete source range. Retain source storage through stage use.
fn rs_read(stage: *RsStage, source: *RmdSource, begin: usize, end: usize) -> bool {
    var hooks: RmdReaderHooks = make RmdReaderHooks {
        user: stage as *u8, declaration: rs_read_declaration,
        statement: rs_read_statement, prefix: rs_read_prefix, type_syntax: rs_read_type
    };
    var unit_value: *RmdUnit = rr_read((*stage).context, source, begin, end, &hooks);
    if unit_value == null(*RmdUnit) { (*stage).failed = true; return false; }
    return true;
}
